purpose: Preserve the more reference-like fragmented triangular silhouette while removing visible joint gaps through a continuous low-poly outer shell plus overlapping project-owned connector geometry.

assetAuthorship.meshMethod: continuous fragment proxy from user-provided generated source geometry; source texture, UVs, and materials removed

gapPolicy.outerShell: single continuous decimated shell compressed into an internal dark filler so the approved skeleton and clean armor define the visible silhouette
gapPolicy.innerShadowShell: slightly smaller dark duplicate shell blocks see-through holes without splitting the silhouette
gapPolicy.cleanArmorPanels: large procedural front-facing armor panels cover noisy shards while keeping the approved black skeleton layout
gapPolicy.connectors: small overlapping black sockets/cylinders are inserted into shoulders, spine, hips, knees, ankles, wrists, and core recess
gapPolicy.knownTradeoff: this visual candidate favors no-gap silhouette over fully separated limb deformation; later node cuts should happen inside these overlap bands

fragmentLinkedProxy.noiseFilter: removed tiny and high-aspect splinter triangles before gap fill and panel overlay
